room_rent.note: Policy covers Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent with no stated cap or sub-limit on room category in the Schedule of Benefits.

icu.note: ICU Charges covered up to Sum Insured with no stated sub-limit.

copayment.display: 20% (age 61–65 at first entry; also 20% on all Medical Treatment Abroad claims)
copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay for insured persons aged 61–65 years covered for the first time; cannot be waived. Separate mandatory 20% co-pay on all Medical Treatment Abroad (Benefit 2) claims; can be waived via optional Co-pay Waiver cover.

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹1L/eye; Bariatric ₹10L; Prosthetics ₹10L; Maternity ₹1L/₹2L; Mental health ₹1Cr cap; OPD ₹50k/yr
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹1,00,000 per eye; Bariatric Surgery up to ₹10,00,000; Prosthetic Devices up to ₹10,00,000; Normal delivery maternity ₹1,00,000, C-section ₹2,00,000; Mental healthcare capped at lower of SI or ₹1Cr; OPD sub-limit ₹50,000/yr; Domiciliary up to 10% of SI; Accidental Hospitalisation increase capped at ₹10,00,000; Repatriation ₹1,00,000; Child vaccination ₹10,000; Accompanying person ₹500/day.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, stones, etc.; 36-month wait for rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint replacement (degenerative), osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.display: Covered (24mo wait if self+spouse; 36mo if self only)
maternity.note: Normal delivery up to ₹1,00,000; C-section up to ₹2,00,000 (including pre/post-natal). 24-month wait if both self and spouse covered; 36-month wait if only self covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year; reduces at same rate if claim made; maximum 100% of base SI.

restoration.note: Restored once per policy year after full exhaustion of SI + CB; usable only for different/unrelated illness; not available for maternity claims.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (400+ listed in Annexure II)
day_care.note: Covered up to Sum Insured; list of 400+ procedures in Annexure II; also covers any other surgery requiring <24hr hospitalisation due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Requires treatment for minimum 3 continuous days; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured at AYUSH Hospital.

organ_donor.note: Covers harvesting expenses for organ donor when insured is recipient; donor screening and post-hospitalisation expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹50,000; Air ambulance up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year within India. Abroad (excl. USA/Canada) also covered subject to claim acceptance under Benefit 2.

modern_treatments.note: Policy covers any surgical/procedure requiring <24hr hospitalisation due to technological advancement; robotic/keyhole surgery referenced in critical illness definitions.

consumables.note: Annexure III lists many consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) as excluded. No optional consumables rider offered.

global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad inbuilt for listed critical illnesses and emergencies excluding USA/Canada; 20% co-pay applies. Optional Benefit 25 extends cover to USA and Canada.

notable_exclusions: USA/Canada treatment (unless optional add-on); sterility/IVF; gender change; cosmetic surgery; durable medical equipment; external congenital anomaly; STDs (non-HIV); stem cell storage
optional_riders: Co-pay Waiver for Medical Treatment Abroad (Benefit 24); Treatment including USA & Canada extension (Benefit 25)
